text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When asked about her goal, Tosen Jordan 
gives an utterly vague answer: "To make it 
big!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A stark contrast to her carefree attitude 
during training, her body froze stiff 
right before her debut race. "What if... I 
can't even run properly out there?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her frightened, the Trainer figured 
it would be easier for her to confide in a 
friend, leaving Tosen Jordan in the care 
of Mejiro Palmer, who had come to cheer 
her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan's fears gently melted away. 
When she stood before her Trainer once 
more, she had a look of fiery 
determination on her face.
